main_subject.detail: A close-up wet-beauty composition showing Cocoon Gleditsia scalp scrub tube and Gleditsia scalp tonic bottle beside a tall glass filled with pale foamy liquid, while a water stream falls from above onto the scrub tube.

items: Top Left: Gleditsia scalp scrub tube standing behind the glass, dotted with water droplets.

Bottom Right: Amber tonic bottle with plum label in the foreground, slightly tilted inward.
Center/Background: Soft cream wall and golden side light creating a warm glossy ritual feel.
